body.statement:
Writing \(N=Km\), Gao--Ge--Qian Theorem 1 displays, for \(d>4\), the upper-rate expression
\[
N^{-1/2}+\min\{K^{-1},K^{-1/2}m^{-2/d}\},
\]
whereas their Proposition 2 prints the high-dimensional lower-rate expression
\[
\min\{K^{-2}(m\log m)^{-2/d},N^{-1/2}\}.
\]

attestation.note: Transcribed from the PMLR published PDF; the node only renames total sample size from \(n\) to \(N\) and writes \(m=N/K\).
